usage: The phrase 交租 (gaau1 zou1) is commonly used as a verb phrase meaning 'to pay rent.'
You can use 交租 in everyday conversation when talking about paying monthly housing fees.
It is often followed by a time reference, like 交月租 (pay monthly rent) or 交房租 (pay house rent).
Negative forms can be made using 唔交租 (not pay rent) or 未交租 (haven't paid rent yet).
To ask if someone has paid rent, you can say 你交咗租未？ (Have you paid rent yet?).
